attributes.action: NI assembly ministers should agree and set a budget
attributes.additional_details:
Northern Irish residents are being punished because the governing parties will not agree a budget.  Budgets for the running of the country should not be conditional on whether or not 35 individuals can or cannot walk along a road.

This damages our children's education, our health services and a variety of jobs are in jeopardy in our essential public services.   If it is not resolved, then we who sign will remember this as we approach the upcoming assembly election .
attributes.background: Once again the main parties in the Northern Ireland Assembly are holding the country to ransom.  A budget should be discussed and agreed and this should not be conditional on party political arguments around marching and policing.

rejection.details: As currently drafted, this petition is a matter for the Northern Ireland Executive and Assembly and not directly a matter for the UK Government at the moment.
